title: Tseitin assignments determine circuit values
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs, and suppose every gate has at most two arguments. If a Boolean assignment satisfies the conjunction of the Tseitin clauses for all gates of $C$, then for every vertex $v<n+|C.	ext{gates}|$, the value computed at $v$ from the input assignment agrees with the given assignment at $v$.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate of $C$ has at most two arguments
